name: gtm
title: Google Tag Manager
about:
Loads your Google Tag Manager container on every public page, with no theme edits. Enter the container ID (for example GTM-ABC1234) in the plugin's Settings tab and save. Cached pages refresh when you save, and an empty ID turns the tag off.
The loader script runs only after you grant the plugin site scripts under Plugins, then Permissions. Without that grant the container is never loaded.
Limits: no noscript fallback, no consent mode, and no server-side Tag Manager domain. If your site enforces a Content Security Policy, the container stays blocked until you allow it. A mistyped but well-formed ID is accepted, because the plugin cannot check that the container exists.
features: Container ID set in the plugin settings, no theme edits
ID is checked before anything loads
Never loads the same container twice
Cached pages refresh when you save
Leave the ID empty to turn the tag off
